THE ASL PERSPECTIVE

Clarity begins with the material.

A specimen may be small, but the questions behind it can be significant.

Composition, identity, sample condition and intended use all influence what an examination needs to address. At Aurum Standard Laboratories, minerals, gold, diamonds and gemstones come together in one clear conversation: what is the material, what matters, and what would useful information look like?
